meta.source: agenticcorepk.com: Services and Prices, introductory prices, 27 September 2026
meta.monthly_includes: Monthly packages include a monthly report, a WhatsApp group with our team, a planning call and two rounds of changes per design.
meta.monthly_includes_ur: ماہانہ پیکجز میں ماہانہ رپورٹ، ہماری ٹیم کے ساتھ واٹس ایپ گروپ، ایک پلاننگ کال اور ہر ڈیزائن پر دو بار تبدیلیاں شامل ہیں۔
meta.value_note: Rupee figures in brackets are our normal single-service prices. Items marked "included" have no single-service price and are not counted in the savings. Set-up discounts apply when you stay for the minimum term.
meta.item_value_rule: Each item's value is (price of its price line) × qty, unless 'value' is given explicitly. The validator (scripts/validate-data.mjs) checks the totals below against the pricing PDF.

packages.name: AgenticCore Package
packages.for: New agents, dealers and small businesses who want everything needed to start selling, done in one go for one low price.
packages.for_ur: نئے ایجنٹس، ڈیلرز اور چھوٹے کاروبار جو بیچنا شروع کرنے کے لیے سب کچھ ایک ہی بار، ایک کم قیمت میں چاہتے ہیں۔

packages.delivery: The whole package in 2–3 days. The logo, business cards, receipt book, banners, brochure, posts and videos come the same day; the website and chatbot follow within 2–3 days. Two rounds of changes on each design and 30 days of fixes for the website and chatbot.
